g.text: Floor -0.95 m. Nominal clear height 2.15 m. Room sizes
give the bounding spans in metres.
The bubble cockpit opens into the captain’s wardroom. Two shoulder passages wrap a sealed cargo capsule and
reunite at the turbine. Either route reaches the engine while the cargo doors are shut.
